strings.zh: 您好,这里是度假区的民宿。{NEWLINE}我们将为您提供最舒适的休息体验。{CLEAR}每次休息500元,{CLEAR}请问您现在需要吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello, this is the Resort Zone{NEWLINE}guesthouse. We offer the most{CLEAR}comfortable rest you’ll find.{SCROLL}Each stay is $500. Would you like to{NEWLINE}rest now?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 对不起,您身上的钱不够。
strings.en: I’m sorry, you don’t have enough{NEWLINE}money.

strings.zh: 好的,现在就为您安排。
strings.en: Very well. We’ll get things ready for{NEWLINE}you right away.

strings.zh: 您和您的精灵都已经恢复精神了,{NEWLINE}祝您在度假区玩得愉快。
strings.en: You and your Pokémon are fully{NEWLINE}refreshed. Enjoy your time at the{CLEAR}Resort Zone.

strings.zh: 您好,楼上是娱乐室。{NEWLINE}请随意参观游玩。
strings.en: Hello. Upstairs is the game room. Feel{NEWLINE}free to look around and have fun.

strings.zh: 我信了别人的邪,{NEWLINE}身无分文就出来穷游,{CLEAR}结果现在既没钱住宿、也没钱吃饭。{CLEAR}你能借我1万块吗？
strings.en: I fell for someone’s nonsense and set{NEWLINE}off backpacking without a cent. Now I{CLEAR}can’t afford a room or food.{SCROLL}Could you lend me $10000?

strings.zh: 谢谢你愿意借我钱,{NEWLINE}你可真是个好人！{CLEAR}这个是我在旅行途中捡到的道具,{CLEAR}就送给你吧！
strings.en: Thanks for lending me the money. You’re{NEWLINE}such a good person! Here’s an item I{CLEAR}picked up on my travels. It’s yours!

strings.zh: 你好像也没有那么多钱啊……
strings.en: Looks like you don’t have that much{NEWLINE}money either...

strings.zh: 为啥有的人就能{NEWLINE}啥也不带穷游各地,{CLEAR}这些人的食宿路费{CLEAR}到底是从哪里来的啊。
strings.en: How do some people travel everywhere{NEWLINE}without bringing a thing? Where does{CLEAR}their food, lodging and fare money even{CLEAR}come from?

strings.zh: 休息充分之后,{NEWLINE}就该去联动公园抓精灵了。{CLEAR}这次我一定要抓到玛沙那！
strings.en: Once I’ve rested up, it’s off to the Pal{NEWLINE}Park to catch Pokémon. This time I’m{CLEAR}definitely catching a Meditite!
